name: shell-header
description: Console application header: brand with prefix, dropdown nav menus, global icon actions, hamburger, skip-to-content

meta.name: ShellHeader
meta.description: Console application header: brand with prefix, dropdown nav menus, global icon actions, hamburger, skip-to-content

props.name: brand
props.description: Brand: { prefix?, name, href? } or free-form node

props.name: nav
props.description: Top nav: links ({ label, href, active?, onClick? }) or dropdown menus ({ label, items })

props.name: center
props.description: Free-form slot between the nav and the right-hand cluster, taking the header’s spare width — where a command-palette or search trigger belongs

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-aligned global icon actions with aria-pressed

props.name: end
props.description: Free-form trailing slot (user menu, theme switcher)

props.name: onMenuClick
props.description: Renders the hamburger button; call shell.toggleSideNav

props.name: skipToContentHref
props.description: Skip-link target; false disables the link

typeDefs.name: ShellHeaderAction
typeDefs.description: A right-aligned global icon action. `actions` is a typed array of these — pass an `icon` node per item, not free-form JSX. For non-action trailing content (user menu, theme switcher) use the `end` slot instead.

fields.name: active
fields.description: Renders aria-pressed for a toggle action.

fields.name: onClick
fields.description: Invoked when the action is activated.

typeDefs.name: ShellHeaderBrand
typeDefs.description: Structured brand for the `brand` prop (or pass any ReactNode instead).

fields.name: prefix
fields.description: Muted text before the name (e.g. an org).

fields.name: href
fields.description: Link target for the brand (routed via setLinkComponent).

typeDefs.name: ShellHeaderNavItem
typeDefs.description: A top-nav entry: either a link (`{ label, href, active?, onClick? }`) or a dropdown menu (`{ label, items: { label, href, active? }[] }`).

fields.name: href
fields.description: Link target (link items). Routed via setLinkComponent.

fields.name: items
fields.type: { label: string; href: string; active?: boolean }[]

fields.name: onClick
fields.description: Intercept navigation (e.g. a SPA section switch).

examples.title: Console header
examples.description: Brand with prefix, dropdown nav, global icon action

examples.title: Command-palette trigger in the centre slot
examples.code:
<ShellHeader
  brand={{ name: 'Console', href: '/' }}
  center={
    <Button variant="ghost" onClick={openPalette}>
      Search incidents, alerts, services… <Kbd>⌘K</Kbd>
    </Button>
  }
  end={<UserMenu />}
/>
examples.description: center takes the header’s spare width, so the trigger grows and shrinks with the viewport instead of being pinned right like end

whenToUse: Building console/admin app chrome with brand, dropdown nav, and global icon actions
Providing a hamburger that toggles a SideNav and a skip-to-content link
Hosting global controls (notifications, switcher, user menu) in one top bar
whenNotToUse: A simple marketing or app top bar — use Header

antiPatterns.bad: Reaching for ShellHeader on a basic landing page
antiPatterns.why: ShellHeader carries console machinery (dropdowns, icon actions, hamburger) that is overkill for simple sites

related.name: SideNav
related.reason: The hamburger toggles a SideNav in the app shell

related.name: Header
related.reason: Header is the simpler top bar for non-console apps

intent.a11yRationale: role="banner" landmarks the header; nav dropdowns expose aria-expanded, icon actions use aria-pressed, the hamburger reports aria-expanded, and a skip-to-content link lets keyboard users bypass the chrome

flexibility.note: Brand, nav, actions, and end are composable and optional
Surfaces, sizing, and accent must resolve to --cascivo-* shell tokens
